convert_markdown_base64_images: convert markdown base64 image strings to uploaded file URLs in markdown content
get_image_base64_from_url: get image base64 data from an HTTP URL or stored file ID
get_image_url_from_base64: upload a base64-encoded image and return its stored URL
get_audio_url_from_base64: upload a base64-encoded WAV audio and return its stored URL
get_file_url_from_base64: dispatch base64 image or audio data to the appropriate upload handler and return URL
